steps.example: Then the receipt matches its baseline
steps.doc: The printed receipt equals the case's reviewed receipt, after the declared normalisers.

steps.text: the transaction log matches its baseline
steps.example: And the transaction log matches its baseline
steps.doc: The sale's TLog from the Commander equals the case's reviewed TLog.

steps.example: When pump 1 dispenses 24.15
steps.doc: Lifts the nozzle and fills to this amount on hose 1 (`PetroPumps.fill_amount`).

steps.example: When pump 1 dispenses 5.00 of its prepay
steps.doc: Fills a prepaid pump to this amount (`PetroPumps.fill_amount(..., prepay=True)`).

steps.example: And the customer hangs up pump 1
steps.doc: Puts the nozzle back (`PetroPumps.handle_down`).

steps.text: the customer hangs up prepaid pump {pump:Number}
steps.example: And the customer hangs up prepaid pump 1
steps.doc: Puts a prepaid pump's nozzle back (`PetroPumps.handle_down(..., prepay=True)`).

steps.example: Given the DCR shows "WELCOME"
steps.doc: Waits, bounded, until DCR 1's display shows this text (`PetroDcr.wait_for_prompt`).

steps.text: the customer presses {key:DcrKey} on the DCR
steps.example: When the customer presses L3 on the DCR
steps.doc: Presses a soft key beside DCR 1's display, L1-L4 or R1-R4 (`PetroDcr.press`).

steps.example: Then the pinpad shows "donate"
steps.doc: Waits, bounded, until the pinpad's screen contains this text (`at_prompt`).

steps.text: the customer presses "{key}" on the pinpad
steps.example: When the customer presses "$0.51" on the pinpad
steps.doc: Presses the pinpad button with this label (`key`).

steps.example: When the customer inserts card "EMV AMMEX CREDIT"
steps.doc: Inserts or swipes the test card with this label (`insert_card`).

steps.text: the pinpad's "{prompt}" prompt clears by itself within {limit:Duration}
steps.example: Then the pinpad's "donate" prompt clears by itself within 90s
steps.doc: Nobody answers: the prompt must time out and leave the screen within the limit.

steps.example: Given the register is idle
steps.doc: The POS shows its idle screen (CSR Func reads idle). Waits for it, bounded.

steps.example: Given a sale is in progress
steps.doc: The POS shows a transaction open. Waits for it, bounded.

steps.example: When the cashier signs on
steps.doc: Signs on as the rig file's cashier, opening the till (`Pos.sign_on`).

steps.text: the cashier signs on and opens the till with a {amount:Money} float
steps.example: When the cashier signs on and opens the till with a 100.00 float
steps.doc: Signs on from the sign-on screen and keys the opening float, checking every prompt.

steps.example: When the cashier signs off
steps.doc: Logs the cashier out from the express panel (`Pos.sign_off`).

steps.example: When the cashier rings up PLU 9999
steps.doc: Keys a PLU on the on-screen keypad and presses OK, as PATS's ADD_ITEM does by touch.

steps.example: And the cashier totals the sale
steps.doc: Presses Total on the item panel.

steps.example: And the customer pays 11.00 in cash
steps.doc: Payment, Cash, then the amount on the numeric keypad and OK (`ItemPanel.pay_cash`).

steps.example: And the customer pays by credit
steps.doc: Payment, then Credit: the pinpad takes over (`ItemPanel.pay_credit`).

steps.example: And the customer pays 10.00 by "CHECK"
steps.doc: Pays an amount with an Other-MOP entry chosen by its label (`Pos.pay_other_mop`).

steps.example: And the customer pays by "MOBILE"
steps.doc: Pays the balance with an Other-MOP entry chosen by its label (`Pos.pay_other_mop`).

steps.example: Then the POS shows error "E1163": "NO CHANGE ALLOWED"
steps.doc: An error overlay with this title and first line is on screen (`Overlay.expect`).

steps.example: And the error message closes
steps.doc: The error overlay has gone (`Overlay.expect_closed`).

steps.example: Then the POS asks "PLEASE SCAN QR CODE"
steps.doc: An input overlay shows this prompt (`InputOverlay.expect_prompt`).

steps.example: When the cashier voids the ticket
steps.doc: Voids the whole sale from the express panel (`Pos.void_ticket`).

steps.example: When the cashier keys PLU 32232211
steps.doc: PATS's ADD_ITEM by key: the PLU and ENTER (`LegacyRmi.add_item`).

steps.example: When the cashier keys 2 of PLU 7002
steps.doc: ADD_ITEM with a quantity: QTY and the count, then the PLU (`LegacyRmi.add_item`).

steps.text: the cashier keys PLU {plu:Number} with modifier {modifier:Number}
steps.example: When the cashier keys PLU 9112 with modifier 1
steps.doc: ADD_ITEM with a modifier (`LegacyRmi.add_item`).

steps.text: the cashier keys {quantity:Number} at {amount:Money} on department key {key:Hex} for department {department:Number}
steps.example: When the cashier keys 1 at 10.77 on department key 0x0c for department 1567
steps.doc: A department sale on another department's number (`LegacyRmi.add_dept_item`).

steps.example: And the cashier keys TOTAL
steps.doc: The TOTAL key.

steps.text: the cashier keys {amount:Money} on the {mop:MopKey} key
steps.example: And the cashier keys 11.00 on the CASH key
steps.doc: Tenders an amount with a MOP key: CASH, CREDIT, OTHER MOP or a 0xNN code.

steps.example: And the cashier keys the CREDIT key
steps.doc: Presses a MOP key with no amount: CREDIT, or CASH to tender the balance.

steps.text: the cashier keys the OTHER MOP key and picks entry {position:Number}
steps.example: And the cashier keys the OTHER MOP key and picks entry 24
steps.doc: OTHER MOP, then an entry of its list by number (`LegacyRmi.other_mop`).

steps.example: And the cashier presses ENTER
steps.doc: A bare ENTER (`LegacyRmi.press_enter`).

steps.example: And the cashier enters "123456"
steps.doc: ENTER carrying the value: an amount, a list entry, a scanned token (`press_enter`).

steps.text: the cashier claims the fuel sale on pump {pump:Number}
steps.example: When the cashier claims the fuel sale on pump 1
steps.doc: Waits for the pump to be idle, then FUEL and the pump: PATS's FUEL, STACKED.

steps.text: the cashier keys a {amount:Money} prepay on pump {pump:Number} with the {mop:MopKey} key
steps.example: When the cashier keys a 5.00 prepay on pump 1 with the CREDIT key
steps.doc: PREPAY and the pump, then the amount on a MOP key (`LegacyRmi.prepay`, by amount).

steps.text: the cashier keys a prepay quantity of {quantity:Money} on pump {pump:Number}
steps.example: When the cashier keys a prepay quantity of 5.00 on pump 4
steps.doc: PREPAY and the pump, then QTY and the quantity (`LegacyRmi.prepay`, by grade).

steps.example: When the cashier presets 14.50 on pump 5
steps.doc: OTHER FUEL, its preset option, the pump and the amount, each with ENTER.

steps.text: the cashier prints flash report {report:Number} from functions menu {functions:Number} of main menu {main:Number}
steps.example: When the cashier prints flash report 4 from functions menu 20 of main menu 1
steps.doc: Walks the menus by number and prints a flash report (`print_flash_report`).

steps.example: When the cashier taps item 145397
steps.doc: Taps one item-panel button by its id (`ItemPanel.select`): the button, not a product.

steps.text: the cashier rings up {quantity:Number} of item {item:Number}
steps.example: When the cashier rings up 2 of item 145390
steps.doc: Quantity, the count, then an item-panel button by its id (`select_with_quantity`).

steps.text: the cashier keys "{digits}" on the {pad:Pad} keypad
steps.example: When the cashier keys "1100" on the numeric keypad
steps.doc: Keys digits then OK on the numeric, calculator or on-screen keypad.

steps.text: the cashier keys "{digits}" on the {pad:Pad} keypad without OK
steps.example: When the cashier keys "12" on the numeric keypad without OK
steps.doc: Keys digits and leaves the entry open: no OK.

steps.text: the cashier presses {key:PadKey} on the {pad:Pad} keypad
steps.example: When the cashier presses CANCEL on the on-screen keypad
steps.doc: OK, CANCEL or CLEAR on one of the keypads.

steps.example: When the cashier taps express button 7
steps.doc: One slot of the express panel, by number.

steps.text: the cashier taps row {row:Number} of the list
steps.example: When the cashier taps row 13631488 of the list
steps.doc: One row of the review overlay's list, by id.

steps.example: When the cashier taps control "EXPRESS_PANEL_VIEW_KEYPAD_ICON"
steps.doc: Any catalogued control by its `locators` name, with slot values in brackets.

steps.example: Given the store imports the "charity" configuration
steps.doc: Imports a folder of petroapps' `AutomationTests/configurations` into the Commander.

steps.example: When the Commander initialises fuel
steps.doc: Sends the fuel initialisation control function (`cfuelinit`).

steps.example: And the Commander initialises the DCRs
steps.doc: Sends the DCR initialisation control function (`cdcrinit`).

steps.example: When the Commander runs control function "cfuelinit"
steps.doc: Sends any CGILink control function by its command name (`control_function`).
